summary: Iter31: Verified UI-speed + WS-payload optimisation brief (P0+P1) end-to-end. Backend: all 3 requested unit test files pass (24/24 in tests/test_ws_hub_slim.py + tests/test_ops_fixes.py + tests/test_rh_feed_gate.py). New /app/backend/tests/test_iter31_regression.py (9 tests, all pass) covers: (a) regression on /api/bot/status,/bot/config,/launches/recent?limit=30,/trades/active,/trades/history?limit=50,/scanner/candidates,/pl/equity all 200 with expected shapes; (b) GET /api/diagnostics/loop.ws_hub returns {clients,seen,ident,frames,bytes,avg_frame_bytes} and enforces seen<=200, ident<=1500; (c) raw wss:// handshake to /api/ws with Bearer+cookie succeeds, receives >=1 JSON {type,data} frame within 6s (status/wallet ticks) and clients>=1 while connected. When candidate/candidate_update frames arrive they carry {seq} and {id,seq,p} respectively (verified in-shape by test, tape idle so no live frames observed on preview — slim-wire covered by unit tests). Frontend (browser + Bearer cookie): /dashboard loads, [data-testid=ws-status] reads 'WS LIVE'; during a 30s WS-live idle window /api/scanner/candidates and /api/ladder had ZERO requests (P0.2 confirmed). Equity chart renders, equity-more -> pl-tf-5m and pl-view-wicks chips switch without errors; kpi-slots, active-trades-card, cockpit-candidates, equity-chart all present. Trade history capped at 50 rows (P0.5 confirmed). After /login -> /dashboard round-trip, exactly ONE /api/ws socket alive (P0.4 confirmed). Zero pageerrors; 5 benign console warnings (Canvas willReadFrequently x3 + 2 transient 'WebSocket closed before established' during initial reconnect handshake — not errors). Full pytest suite (backend background run /tmp/pytest_full.log) 717 passed / 63 skipped / 1 failed — the 1 failure is test_rh_integration_api_v9.py::test_status_healthy expecting RH head>55M while RH feed is intentionally OFF per brief (pre-existing, unrelated to this iteration).

minor.issue: test_rh_integration_api_v9::test_status_healthy fails because RH feed is intentionally OFF in preview — assertion 'head>55M' fires against head=0. Not a regression, expected while rh_feed_enabled=false.

issues: Tab bar buttons LIVE/SCAN/LADDER/DOCTOR/BOOKS/CONTROL/WIKI do not carry data-testid=tab-live etc. Testing had to fall back to role/text selectors. Add data-testid to each tab for stable Playwright automation.

graduate-ladder and trade-history panels render correctly (visible in screenshot) but do not expose data-testid=graduate-ladder / trade-history at the panel level — only row-level testids exist. Consider adding container testids.

action_items: Consider adding data-testid=tab-live/tab-scan/tab-ladder/tab-doctor/tab-books/tab-control/tab-wiki to the tab bar buttons for stable e2e automation.
Optional: expose data-testid=graduate-ladder and data-testid=trade-history at the panel container level (row-level testids exist but not container).
critical_code_review_comments: ws_hub.py slim frame shape verified by unit tests: candidate carries {seq}, candidate_update carries {id,seq,p:{...}} — patch-only payload is correct.
Frontend behavior confirms P0.2: scanner/ladder polling is fully suppressed while wsConnected=true (0 REST hits in 30s idle window).
P0.4 verified: single /api/ws socket alive across login->dashboard round-trip; no leaked reconnect timers.
P0.5 verified: history_rows count stays at exactly 50 (cap).

Reverse-fallback test (block /api/ws -> expect polling to resume + 'WS OFFLINE') could NOT be validated via Playwright route.abort because ws upgrade requests aren't reliably intercepted by page.route — the header stayed 'WS LIVE' and no polling resumed. Recommend adding a manual verification via DevTools 'Offline' mode if 100% coverage on that branch is required. The forward direction (WS up -> polling quiet) is definitively verified.

success_rate.backend: 100% (24/24 named unit tests + 9/9 iter31 regression + WS handshake)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for the objectives observable with the bot stopped and feeds off

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter31_regression.py assumes /api/bot/status has keys {enabled, active_trade_count} (state key not present). /launches/recent?limit=30 returns UP TO 60 rows (30 SOL + 30 RH combined). websocket-client is installed. For the WS-offline branch you cannot use Playwright route.abort against the ws upgrade — instead disable the browser network via CDP or use DevTools offline. When the tape is idle (bot stopped) no live 'candidate'/'candidate_update' frames stream; slim shape is fully covered by unit tests in test_ws_hub_slim.py.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — feature verification iteration, no bug hunt. All P0 (rAF flush / poll-only-when-WS-off / memoized callbacks / reconnect leak fix / list caps) and P1 (slim candidate frames + patch updates + diagnostics + EquityChart series.update tail path) requirements observed working.
